note: Death Valley NP campground on the open valley floor below sea level, a half mile north of the Furnace Creek Visitor Center; mostly unshaded. Tent-only sites 100-110 and 115-150 and group sites 1-4 take no RVs or campervans. Park entrance fee on top. Summer heat is extreme, and some loops close then. --Claude
summary: Furnace Creek (DEVA): $30 base, +$14 for full hookups (18 sites, 50A/water/sewer), max 8 people; reservable Oct 15-Apr 15 (5 days to 6 months ahead), first-come in summer with 41 sites; open year-round. Flush toilets, dump, water, no showers. Entrance $30/vehicle for 7 days. NPS website line is a 404.
